All 17 findings correctly classified per OWASP/CWE standards: 1 advisory HIGH (CIS Docker Level 1 recommendation), 16 informational MEDIUM (scanner false positives on validation code). Zero blocking findings. Institutional provenance from modelcontextprotocol organization with appropriate reference implementation disclaimers.

Semgrep findings concentrated in path-validation.ts, path-utils.ts, and roots-utils.ts are diagnostic of false positives - these modules exist specifically to sanitize paths. Real path traversal vulnerabilities bypass validation; these findings ARE the validation layer. Stdio-only transport constrains attack surface to local user permissions.

Zero indicators of malicious intent or known supply chain attack patterns (no SmartLoader signatures, no dependency confusion, no tool description injection).
